items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: It was Stan Kenton’s band and Shorty Rogers and Shelly Manne, Art Tatum Trio, June Christy, Lennie — oh I can’t think of his name

ctx.x: Yeah. The term was colored. So the coloreds would be in the balcony. They could listen but they couldn’t come down and dance. I don’t know if they danced in the hallways or anything like that because we couldn’t see. But they were definitely segregated. And we didn’t have any Black guys in the band with Benny in the year — I was on tour with Stan Kenton in 1954 when I was with Charlie Ventura. And there was two buses there were so many people on this tour. It was a great — he called it the Festival of Modern…
